d:
The OCC crew is back with another FANtasy Bike contest build, but this time, the winner has something completely different in mind! Bryan King wants a massive custom three-wheeled chopper, pushing Paul Jr., Rick Petko and the fabrication team into an entirely new engineering challenge. With complex metalwork, drivetrain troubles and Paul Sr. demanding progress, the crew races to turn Bryan's dream trike into reality.
Watch American Chopper Season 3 Episode 65 only on discovery+ India.
